comment: opening.json continued: the opening cutscene (START through the narration, A through its messages) to the Four Sword room, then walking, sword swings, a spin attack, A to pick up / talk, then A every 30 (ends in script_timeout by design). docs/HARNESS_DOLPHIN.md

steps.comment: 0: boot loader until the title (mode 1)
1: title: START until the main menu (mode 2)
2: main menu: A on Hyrulean Adventure, then A on its START! button, until the file select (mode 3)
3: file select: wait for the 'create a file for this game on the Memory Card in Slot A?' prompt (state 7)
4: move its cursor to Yes (field_0x114 0)
5: A on Yes: state 8 writes the file, state 9 waits for the card
6: until the card write is done ('file created' message, state 10)
7: the message closes by itself; wait for the file rows (state 5, picking a file)
8: A on file 1, then A on its menu, until the stage loader (mode 4)
9: player count (mode 4): A on Single-Player Game (and on what follows) until the stage is chosen (stage 8, level 3)
10: the stage loads: the opening narration
11: narration: START every 30 until the demo timer (fn_8011921C()->field_0x8) restarts after it (the cutscene)
12: the cutscene walks Link up to the Four Sword room; A every 30 for its messages, until its demo timer stops at 1551 (Link below the sword, controllable)
sword swings
walk left and back
walk down and back
spin attack: hold B, release
step up to the sword
grab the Four Sword: hold A, then pull back (stick down) with A held
A on the Four Sword, then A every 30 through what follows (ends in script_timeout by design)
